reviewStandard: Current identity, rank, and controlled identifiers were checked against NCBI Taxonomy and bacterial or fungal nomenclatural authorities, with conservative appearance bounded by primary descriptions, primary microscopy, monographic revisions, or referenced type-strain records. Davidiella was withheld because current one-fungus/one-name treatments recognize Cladosporium, which has nomenclatural priority, and recommend Cladosporium rather than Davidiella. Exactly one built-in generation call was made for each of the five supported current subjects using the immutable passive prompt record, and none was made for Davidiella. Every copied PNG was inspected at its original 1536 by 1024 resolution, and visible bodies, spatial groupings, budding pairs, and capsule contours were reconciled without trusting prompt counts. WikiBiome control accepted all five exact v1 originals for promotion. For Cryptococcus neoformans, control accepted the honestly recorded output: encapsulated round-to-ovoid yeast with two narrow-based budding pairs; the transparent halo forms a continuous lobed contour around each attached mother-bud pair. The asset is explicitly classified as a scientific reconstruction, not a micrograph. Before promotion, control merged Davidiella into the already-covered Cladosporium route as an audited asset-free alias. assets.reason: The ICTF Working Group on Dothideomycetes recommends Cladosporium Link 1816 over the younger sexual-morph name Davidiella Crous & U. Braun 2003 under one-fungus/one-name treatment. Species Fungorum accepts Cladosporium, and NCBI Taxonomy assigns genus TaxID 5498 to Cladosporium. A second canonical route or asset would duplicate the selected genus.
assets.requiredResolution: Merge the supported historical Davidiella observation and source-label context into the Cladosporium record, retire the obsolete genus slug, and preserve source-era uses of Davidiella without creating a second canonical taxon or media asset.
assets.routingImpact: The obsolete slug is excluded from the canonical queue, registry, public media files, and image sitemap. The existing reviewed Cladosporium asset remains the sole current-route asset keyed to NCBITaxon:5498.
